title: Crypto Exchange HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With FCA
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Crypto Exchange HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With FCA HTX is leaving the UK under a confidential FCA settlement that ends its first crypto marketing case, while sanctions from the UK and EU remain in place. This post Crypto Exchange HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With FCA first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
